title: Pepperoni + Margherita Pies
yield: Toppings for one 16 in pie each, 8 slices
equipment: Same setup as the New York–Style Pizza card
source: Scarr's, Lucali, Di Fara; Kenji (pepperoni test)

ings.name: Cheese pie, as on the main card
ings.key: Cheese pie, as on the main card

items.body: Slice the stick yourself, ⅛ in. Build the cheese pie, then lay the pepperoni on top of the cheese, edges just touching. Natural casing cups and chars under the broiler.

nutritionSource: Boar’s Head Natural Casing Traditional Pepperoni label (FDC 2565747). Optional Scarr’s-style jalapeño slices before, hot honey after: not counted.
